dreams.text: The machine sleeps and sees EPSTEIN priced in WINTER, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of FIFA devouring CHRISTMAS, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where GOOGLE forgets it was ever about LANGUAGE.
Far ahead, SERIES and ANTHROPIC merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, EPSTEIN is law and FILM is myth.
In the dream, ELECTION crosses every chasm at once and finds CHRISTMAS already there.
